Package com.zetaplugins.zetacore

Class ZetaCorePlugin

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.plugin.PluginBase
org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin
com.zetaplugins.zetacore.ZetaCorePlugin
All Implemented Interfaces:
LifecycleEventOwner, CommandExecutor, TabCompleter, TabExecutor, Plugin
public abstract class ZetaCorePlugin extends JavaPlugin
Base class for plugins built on ZetaCore.

On enable, the plugin boots itself. It saves the default config, creates the ConfigService and ServiceRegistry, registers the beans of all Configuration classes and starts eagerly loaded services and beans. It then registers everything found in the plugin's package:

  • permissions (see PermissionHolder)
  • commands and tab completers, filtered by CommandRegistrationCustomizers
  • event listeners
  • Papi placeholders, if PlaceholderAPI is installed, customized by PlaceholderExpansionCustomizers
Finally, it starts bStats if ZetaPlugin.bstatsId() is set (charts come from MetricsCustomizers) and runs every UpdateChecker service or bean asynchronously.

Use ZetaPlugin on the main class to change the defaults, and override onStartup() and onShutdown() for custom logic.

The plugin itself, its Logger, the ConfigService, the ServiceRegistry, the ClassScanner and every ConfigFile class can be injected into any service. Injected config objects are updated in place by ConfigService.reload().
